title: Toroidal Knight = Q4 Hypercube Packet

gray_cycle.role: Gray-code Hamilton clock for packet routing/syndrome extraction

packet_axis_interpretation.factorization: Q4 bits realize 2 orientation x 2 chart-bit x 2 chart-bit x 2 chirality = 16 slots

architecture_upgrade: Corrects and strengthens CCCCXII: the 4x4 toroidal knight routing graph is Q4, so the 16-slot tomotope/chirality packet is a true 4-bit hypercube packet with a Gray-code syndrome/routing clock.
theorem: The 4x4 toroidal knight graph is isomorphic to the 4-cube Q4 under the explicit labeling in this file. The CCCCXII closed knight tour maps to a Gray-code Hamilton cycle on Q4, with bit-flip sequence 1,2,1,3,1,2,1,0 repeated twice.
honesty_boundary: This identifies the packet routing graph and hypercube clock. The global W33-to-packet subsystem distance still requires constructing and checking the integrated stabilizer/gauge matrix.
